headline: 1,240 customers were told “Payment failed” after paying
cause: Android app 8.2 skips the verify-payment call after UPI

answer.title: Your app never told your server about these payments
answer.text: Since app 8.2 went live at 7:40 pm, the app shows “Payment failed” after UPI payments that Razorpay captured. Your server was never asked to verify them, so no order was confirmed. Razorpay and the banks were working normally.

compared: Compared with your payments in the 30 minutes before the release
cannot_see: customers who paid another way, such as cash on delivery or another gateway

root.cause: App 8.2 skips the verify-payment call after UPI, so orders stay unconfirmed and the app shows “Payment failed”.
root.fix: Roll back 8.2, or patch the verify-payment call.
signals: no verify-payment call for any of these payments

actions.title: Refund 410 duplicate payments
actions.text: ₹4,97,890 goes back to each customer's original payment method.

actions.title: Send your order team 830 paid orders
actions.text: ₹10,71,170 was paid with no order. The list has payment IDs, amounts and times, to confirm each order.

actions.title: Message 830 customers
actions.text: Tells them their payment went through and their order is confirmed, in your name. It waits until the orders are confirmed.

closing: Explained 6 minutes after the alert and signed off by Razorpay support at 7:59 pm. The cause was your app, not Razorpay or a bank.

app.said_more: Something went wrong. Please try again.

alert.rule: Payment errors, more than 20 in 10 minutes, are sent to Razorpay Resolve
